subject: Urgent: third-party claim — triage & evidence capture (CycloGen)
messages:
From: Alice Yang <alice.yang@cyclogen.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cyclogen.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: Patent assertion notice re: model output

Dylan —

We received an assertion from BioProbe (attached) alleging that certain diagnostic sequences appearing in outputs from our integration with Redwood-derived model responses overlap with BioProbe's patented assay methods. They sent a formal "Notice of Infringement" on 2026-12-17 and are requesting immediate remediation and indemnity under Section 9 of our MSA.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Please confirm Redwood has preserved inference logs, model versioning, and any fine-tuning data or prompts related to CycloGen traffic from 2026-11-01 to present.
- We need a named technical contact at Redwood who can pull and export logs and provide a short report of how the outputs were generated (model, temperature, sampling).
- Legal: we will need to discuss defense control vs. right-to-select counsel and scope of any indemnity or holdback.

I am cc'ing Raj (PM) who is coordinating on our side. We appreciate a first-response timeline within 48 hours so we can confirm next steps to BioProbe and preserve our rights.

Attachment: BioProbe_Notice_20261217.pdf (patent assertion; redlines highlighted)

Thanks,
Alice Yang
General Counsel
CycloGen Therapeutics
alice.yang@cyclogen.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Alice Yang <alice.yang@cyclogen.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Urgent: Patent assertion notice re: model output

Kimberly — forwarding CycloGen's notice (below). Customer is asking for indemnity per MSA Section 9 and wants logs + a technical contact.

Quick context: CycloGen is on an annual committed plan (deal RD-2468). They recently enabled a customer-facing assistant that surfaces sequence recommendations — that surfaced the flagged content. They notified two days ago and asked for a formal response.

Priority: please triage legal stance (defend vs. reimburse/damage cap exposure) and recommend immediate customer-facing language we can use to acknowledge receipt and proposed timeline. Also need to know if we will seek defense control or propose a compromise (e.g., Redwood manages response but subject to customer's choice of counsel for IP-specific litigation).

Could you also confirm who on infra/edge can pull: inference logs, request/response payloads (redacted PHI if any), model config (model id, weights/quantization, tokenization), and any fine-tune manifests? Mateo, can you take tech lead on that if Kimberly asks?

Attaching the CycloGen MSA and the notice from BioProbe for reference.

Attachments: CycloGen_MSA_20251201.pdf, BioProbe_Notice_20261217.pdf

Thanks — I want to get a calm, clear reply to Alice within 48 hours.

—Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Yang <alice.yang@cyclogen.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Urgent: Patent assertion notice re: model output

Thanks for the flag, Dylan — I've reviewed the MSA excerpt and the BioProbe notice. Initial legal triage below.

High-level stance (recommended):
- Acknowledge receipt and confirm preservation of logs; propose an initial investigatory period (5 business days) during which Redwood will collect and share non-privileged technical artifacts.
- Push back on unconditional defense control. Offer a compromise: Redwood will coordinate the technical investigation and offer to lead initial negotiations, but any litigation defense/control will be subject to customer approval for selection of outside counsel if litigation proceeds.
- Reserve rights and do not admit liability in any customer-facing message.

Immediate customer-facing language (we can send this today):
"Alice — thanks for sending this. We take third-party IP claims seriously. We have preserved logs and started an internal investigation; we will share a high-level technical summary within 5 business days and propose next steps for remediation or mitigation. Our legal team will coordinate on scope of indemnity and defense logistics; we will not waive rights or admit liability in the interim."

Information we need from infra/engineering (please prioritize):
1) Inference logs for CycloGen account from 2026-11-01 to present (timestamps, model_id, request_id, response_id).
2) Representative input examples that produced the contested outputs (redact customer PII/PHI).
3) Model config + actual model checksum (to show whether a default public checkpoint was used).
4) Any fine-tune training manifests if CycloGen requested training from customer-supplied data.

Attachments: draft_response_talking_points.docx, redline_msa_indemnity.docx (highlights proposed language for negotiation).

Proposed timeline:
- 48 hours: send acknowledgement and one-line triage note.
- 5 business days: deliver technical summary and candidate remediation steps.
- Post-summary: legal to propose indemnity approach (defend-vs-reimburse options) and relevant redlines to the order form.

Mateo — please confirm you can run the extraction and provide an initial artifact bundle by EOD tomorrow (12/21). If you need more time, flag now.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

ETA: initial bundle uploaded to the shared folder by 2026-12-21 10:00 PST.

Alice — thank you for sending the BioProbe notice and for the clear asks. Per Kimberly and Mateo:

What we are doing now (summary & next steps):
- Acknowledgement: we have received the notice and preserved relevant systems and logs.
- Technical artifacts: Mateo will upload an initial artifact bundle (inference logs + 10 redacted sample request/response pairs + model config snapshot) to the shared CycloGen folder by 2026-12-21 10:00 PST.

- Redwood position: we will coordinate the investigation; for litigation-level defense control we will need to negotiate scope with CycloGen (we will not unilaterally accept litigation control at this stage).

Immediate ask of you: please confirm whether CycloGen performed any customer-provided fine-tuning hosted by Redwood or whether you used prompt templates that CycloGen manages. That will materially affect attribution.

Attachments we are sharing internally: draft_response_talking_points.docx, redline_msa_indemnity.docx (we will share a redline proposal after the technical summary).

We aim to have a high-level technical summary and proposed next steps to you by 2026-12-27 (5 business days). If anything changes earlier, we will update.

Thanks — we appreciate your partnership and will treat this with priority.
